description: This file defines a Java interface named JobNameProvider, which declares a method provide() that returns a set of JobNameData objects. It serves as a contract for classes that will supply job name data within the Fineract infrastructure's job service module.

classes.name: JobNameProvider
classes.description: An interface providing a contract for classes that supply job name data.

methods.name: provide
methods.description: Returns a set of JobNameData objects representing available job names.
